lead.id: Rencana PLTN di RUPTL dan KEN baru, Thorcon, BRIN, Bapeten, dan pelajaran Barakah, Bataan, dan NuScale: apa yang sudah dan belum ada di Indonesia.
lead.en: Nuclear plans in RUPTL and the new national energy policy, Thorcon, BRIN, Bapeten, and lessons from Barakah, Bataan and NuScale: what exists and what does not yet in Indonesia.

label.en: Target operation of the first plant

penting.id: PP 40/2025 menempatkan nuklir bukan opsi terakhir; target PLTN pertama 2032 sampai 2034, tetapi belum ada izin tapak per Agustus 2025.
penting.en: PP 40/2025 places nuclear as no longer a last resort; the first plant is targeted for 2032 to 2034, but no site permit existed as of August 2025.

penting.id: Satu-satunya pemohon yang diketahui, Thorcon di Pulau Gelasa, baru memegang persetujuan evaluasi tapak Bapeten dan menghadapi penolakan lokal.
penting.en: The only known applicant, Thorcon on Gelasa Island, holds only a Bapeten site evaluation approval and faces local opposition.

penting.id: Dunia menunjukkan dua jalan: Barakah selesai tepat dengan kontrak harga tetap, sedangkan Bataan mangkrak dan proyek SMR NuScale dibatalkan.
penting.en: The world shows two paths: Barakah finished with a fixed-price contract, while Bataan stalled and NuScale's SMR project was cancelled.

posisi.id: Indonesia belum memiliki PLTN dan porsi nuklirnya 0 persen (2024), sementara tiga reaktor riset BRIN menjadi satu-satunya fasilitas nuklir beroperasi.
posisi.en: Indonesia has no nuclear plant and a 0 percent nuclear share (2024); three BRIN research reactors are its only operating nuclear facilities.

t.en: When is Indonesia's first nuclear plant?

j.id: Target pemerintah 2032 sampai 2034 dengan kapasitas awal 500 MW (Dewan Energi Nasional, 3 Mar 2026). Pada Februari 2025 Dirjen EBTKE menyebut 250 MW pada 2032; angka awal berbeda antarpernyataan.
j.en: The government target is 2032 to 2034 with an initial 500 MW (National Energy Council, 3 Mar 2026). In February 2025 the EBTKE director general cited 250 MW in 2032; initial figures differ between statements.

t.en: Is there a site permit yet?

j.id: Belum per 12 Agu 2025: Bapeten baru menerbitkan persetujuan evaluasi tapak untuk Thorcon 500 di Pulau Kelasa, dan Direktur Jenderal EBTKE menyatakan belum ada yang menerima izin tapak.
j.en: Not as of 12 Aug 2025: Bapeten has only issued a site evaluation approval for Thorcon 500 on Kelasa Island, and the EBTKE director general said no one has received a site permit.

j.id: Bapeten (Badan Pengawas Tenaga Nuklir) menerbitkan persetujuan evaluasi tapak dan izin tahapan lain; keputusan akhir proyek di tangan Menteri ESDM menurut Dirjen EBTKE.
j.en: Bapeten (Nuclear Energy Regulatory Agency) issues the site evaluation approval and later-stage permits; per the EBTKE director general the project's final decision rests with the Energy Minister.

j.id: UU 10/1997 tentang Ketenaganukliran, PP 54/2012 (keselamatan instalasi), PP 2/2014 (perizinan), dan PP 40/2025 tentang Kebijakan Energi Nasional yang menempatkan nuklir bukan opsi terakhir.
j.en: Law 10/1997 on nuclear energy, PP 54/2012 (installation safety), PP 2/2014 (licensing) and PP 40/2025 on National Energy Policy, which no longer treats nuclear as a last resort.

j.id: DEN menyebut 44 GW pada 2060 (35 GW listrik dan 9 GW untuk hidrogen mulai 2045); Februari 2025 ESDM menyebut 42 GW pada 2060.
j.en: DEN cites 44 GW by 2060 (35 GW for electricity and 9 GW for hydrogen from 2045); in February 2025 the ministry cited 42 GW by 2060.

j.id: Ya, tiga reaktor riset BRIN: Serpong 30 MWt, Bandung 2 MWt, Yogyakarta 100 kWt (kutipan pejabat BRIN via Katadata).
j.en: Yes, three BRIN research reactors: Serpong 30 MWt, Bandung 2 MWt, Yogyakarta 100 kWt (BRIN official quoted via Katadata).

j.id: Small modular reactor: reaktor modul kecil, misalnya modul 77 MW pada proyek NuScale yang dibatalkan di AS.
j.en: Small modular reactor: a small modular reactor, e.g. the 77 MW modules in the cancelled NuScale project in the US.

j.id: Ya. Warga Bangka Belitung dan aliansi di Kalimantan Barat menolak; IESR menilai Indonesia tidak membutuhkan nuklir (Mongabay, 23 Feb 2025). Pemerintah dan pengembang berpendapat sebaliknya.
j.en: Yes. Residents of Bangka Belitung and an alliance in West Kalimantan object; IESR says Indonesia does not need nuclear (Mongabay, 23 Feb 2025). The government and developer argue otherwise.

paragraf.id: Nuklir menghasilkan listrik beban dasar tanpa emisi operasi, dan PP 40/2025 menempatkannya sebagai unsur penting rencana jangka panjang, bukan opsi terakhir (DEN, 3 Mar 2026). Dewan Energi Nasional memproyeksikan porsi nuklir naik dari sekitar 0,5 persen menjadi lebih dari 11 persen energi primer pada akhir 2060.
paragraf.en: Nuclear gives baseload power without operating emissions, and PP 40/2025 places it as an important element of long-term plans rather than a last resort (DEN, 3 Mar 2026). The National Energy Council projects nuclear rising from about 0.5 percent to over 11 percent of primary energy by end-2060.

paragraf.id: Risikonya: biaya modal tinggi, waktu bangun panjang, keselamatan, dan penerimaan masyarakat. Bab Kasus menunjukkan proyek yang mangkrak (Bataan) dan dibatalkan (NuScale) di samping yang berhasil (Barakah).
paragraf.en: The risks: high capital cost, long build time, safety and public acceptance. The cases chapters show stalled (Bataan) and cancelled (NuScale) projects beside a success (Barakah).

paragraf.en: The government awaits the New and Renewable Energy bill (RUU EBET) and a revision of the Electricity Law (EBTKE director general, Feb 2025). METI consultation forums and the METI position were not found in the sources read.

paragraf.id: Desain SMR terdepan di dunia Barat, NuScale, memakai modul 77 MW; proyek enam modul (462 MW) di Idaho dibatalkan pada 9 Nov 2023 (POWER Engineering).
paragraf.en: NuScale, the leading Western SMR design, uses 77 MW modules; the six-module (462 MW) project in Idaho was cancelled on 9 Nov 2023 (POWER Engineering).

paragraf.id: Desain besar yang terbukti: APR1400 Korea di Barakah, empat unit total 5,6 GW (World Nuclear Association). Thorcon mengusulkan reaktor garam cair thorium (TMSR500) di Indonesia, tetapi detail kapasitas dan biaya tidak ada di artikel yang dibaca, dan IESR menyebut belum ada proyek percontohan sejenis (Mongabay).
paragraf.en: A proven large design: Korea's APR1400 at Barakah, four units totalling 5.6 GW (World Nuclear Association). Thorcon proposes a thorium molten salt reactor (TMSR500) in Indonesia, but the article read has no capacity or cost detail, and IESR says no comparable pilot exists (Mongabay).

paragraf.id: BRIN mengoperasikan reaktor riset Serpong 30 MWt (kritis 1987) dan sedang merevitalisasi fasilitas bahan bakar nuklir (Mar 2026). Seorang pejabat BRIN menyebut tiga reaktor riset dan SDM yang mumpuni (Katadata).
paragraf.en: BRIN operates the 30 MWt Serpong research reactor (critical in 1987) and is revitalising nuclear fuel facilities (Mar 2026). A BRIN official cites three research reactors and capable personnel (Katadata).

paragraf.id: Analisis METI (Hipotesis): proyek besar yang selesai (Barakah) memiliki regulator mapan, kontrak harga tetap, dan pembiayaan sovereign; proyek yang gagal (Bataan, NuScale) bergantung pada keputusan politik berganti atau kecukupan pelanggan.
paragraf.en: METI analysis (Hypothesis): projects that finished (Barakah) had an established regulator, a fixed-price contract and sovereign financing; projects that failed (Bataan, NuScale) depended on shifting politics or enough subscribers.

paragraf.id: Analisis METI (Hipotesis): urutan yang masih terbuka di Indonesia: regulator, pembiayaan, dan penerimaan masyarakat belum terjawab sebelum teknologi dipilih.
paragraf.en: METI analysis (Hypothesis): the open sequence in Indonesia: regulator, financing and public acceptance remain unanswered before technology is chosen.

paragraf.en: Per the OWID/Ember data held in the repo, no ASEAN country in the list has a nuclear electricity share above zero; Indonesia's nuclear share is 0 percent (2024).

paragraf.id: Perpres 42/2011 mengesahkan persetujuan kerja sama Indonesia dan Korea (dasar kerja sama tertaut di basis regulasi METI; isi persetujuan tidak dibaca). Peta jalan PLTN mengikuti pedoman IAEA (Feb 2025).
paragraf.en: Perpres 42/2011 ratifies an Indonesia-Korea cooperation agreement (linked in the METI regulation base; the agreement text was not read). The nuclear roadmap follows IAEA guidance (Feb 2025).

paragraf.id: Pembanding kawasan: KHNP Korea mendanai studi rehabilitasi Bataan (Okt 2024).
paragraf.en: Regional comparison: Korea's KHNP funded the Bataan rehabilitation study (Oct 2024).

paragraf.id: Barakah dibiayai sekitar USD 24,4 miliar: pinjaman langsung sekitar USD 19,6 miliar (KEXIM 2,5 miliar; empat bank komersial 250 juta; hingga 16,2 miliar dari Departemen Keuangan Abu Dhabi) dan ekuitas USD 4,7 miliar dari ENEC dan KEPCO (World Nuclear Association).
paragraf.en: Barakah was financed with about USD 24.4 billion: direct loans of about USD 19.6 billion (KEXIM 2.5 billion; four commercial banks 250 million; up to 16.2 billion from Abu Dhabi's Department of Finance) and USD 4.7 billion equity from ENEC and KEPCO (World Nuclear Association).

paragraf.id: Struktur pembiayaan PLTN Indonesia belum ada di sumber. Pendanaan publik internasional untuk nuklir Indonesia dalam basis IRENA/OECD hanya USD 13,2 juta kumulatif 2006 sampai 2023 (nilai USD 2023, berbagai proyek kecil).
paragraf.en: The financing structure of an Indonesian plant is not in the sources. International public finance for Indonesian nuclear in the IRENA/OECD database totals only USD 13.2 million cumulative from 2006 to 2023 (2023 USD, small projects).

paragraf.id: Warga Bangka Belitung menolak rencana PLTN karena khawatir bahaya bagi manusia dan lingkungan; TUK Indonesia menilai rencana ini tidak sesuai visi pemerintah dan mengurangi partisipasi masyarakat (Mongabay).
paragraf.en: Residents of Bangka Belitung reject the plan fearing harm to people and the environment; TUK Indonesia says the plan does not fit the government vision and reduces public participation (Mongabay).

paragraf.id: Bapeten menyatakan akan menolak tapak bila ada patahan dalam jarak 5 km, dan evaluasi mencakup seismisitas dan dispersi radioaktif. Di Filipina, dewan Morong yang menaungi Bataan menetapkan wilayahnya zona bebas nuklir (Jun 2026).
paragraf.en: Bapeten says it will reject a site with a fault within 5 km, and the evaluation covers seismicity and radioactive dispersion. In the Philippines, the Morong council hosting Bataan declared its municipality a non-nuclear zone (Jun 2026).

paragraf.id: Seorang peneliti menyebut SDM Indonesia mumpuni membangun PLTN (judul Katadata, Jul 2024); jumlah ahli bersertifikat dan program pendidikan tidak ada dalam sumber yang dibaca.
paragraf.en: A researcher says Indonesian personnel are capable of building a plant (Katadata headline, Jul 2024); the number of certified experts and education programmes is not in the sources read.

paragraf.id: Pendukung: pemerintah menilai nuklir bukan lagi opsi terakhir dan perlu untuk NZE 2060 (DEN, Mar 2026). Pengkritik: Fabby Tumiwa (IESR) menyatakan Indonesia tidak membutuhkan nuklir karena energi terbarukan dapat mewujudkan kemandirian, dan menyoroti pembengkakan biaya 2 sampai 3 kali pada proyek berjalan; ia juga menyebut Thorcon belum punya rekam jejak (Mongabay, 23 Feb 2025).
paragraf.en: Supporters: the government says nuclear is no longer a last resort and is needed for NZE 2060 (DEN, Mar 2026). Critics: Fabby Tumiwa (IESR) says Indonesia does not need nuclear because renewables can deliver self-sufficiency, and cites 2 to 3 times cost overruns on projects under construction; he also says Thorcon lacks a track record (Mongabay, 23 Feb 2025).

paragraf.id: Bapeten menyatakan netral soal perlu tidaknya nuklir dan hanya memastikan standar terpenuhi; pengembang menyatakan sedang menjalani proses perizinan (Listrik Indonesia, judul).
paragraf.en: Bapeten says it is neutral on whether nuclear is needed and only ensures standards are met; the developer says licensing is under way (Listrik Indonesia, headline).

paragraf.id: Analisis METI (Hipotesis): pengembang dan pemasok: peluang awal ada pada rantai pasok non-nuklir (sipil, kelistrikan, logistik) dan jasa keselamatan, bukan reaktor.
paragraf.en: METI analysis (Hypothesis): developers and suppliers: early opportunities lie in the non-nuclear supply chain (civil, electrical, logistics) and safety services, not the reactor.

paragraf.id: Analisis METI (Hipotesis): investor: nilai kepastian izin dan pembeli listrik sebelum modal masuk; pemda: siapkan diskusi publik sejak sebelum evaluasi tapak; akademisi: kapasitas BRIN sebagai mitra uji.
paragraf.en: METI analysis (Hypothesis): investors: value permit and offtaker certainty before capital enters; local governments: prepare public discussion before site evaluation; academics: BRIN capacity as a test partner.

paragraf.en: Issuance of the first site permit and creation of NEPIO and the three site-selection task forces.

paragraf.en: Reconciliation of the initial capacity (250 or 500 MW) and the 2060 target (42 or 44 GW).

paragraf.en: Sources: national and international media, World Nuclear Association country profiles, and the repo regulation and project data, read on 8 Nov 2026. Some pages refused full reads; figures from search summaries are noted.

paragraf.id: Batas: tidak ada dokumen resmi KEN/RUKN yang dibaca langsung; status Bapeten setelah Agu 2025 tidak ditemukan; angka kapasitas awal berbeda antarpernyataan. EST berarti hitung sendiri; Hipotesis berarti sintesis METI.
paragraf.en: Limits: no official KEN/RUKN document was read directly; Bapeten status after Aug 2025 was not found; initial capacity figures differ between statements. EST means self-derived; Hypothesis means METI synthesis.

catatan.id: Hanya satu kasus berhasil Indonesia (reaktor riset) dan satu luar negeri (Barakah) yang bersumber; kasus Korea dan Prancis tidak dibaca.
catatan.en: Only one Indonesian success (a research reactor) and one foreign success (Barakah) are sourced; Korea and France cases were not read.

tindakan.id: Memilih desain Korea, kontrak sebagian besar harga tetap, dan membiayai lewat pinjaman sovereign plus ekuitas operator.
tindakan.en: Chose a Korean design, a largely fixed-price contract, and financed it with sovereign loans plus operator equity.

sebab.id: Regulator tersendiri (FANR), kontrak harga tetap, dan pembiayaan pemerintah Abu Dhabi menurut World Nuclear Association.
sebab.en: A dedicated regulator (FANR), a fixed-price contract and Abu Dhabi government financing per the World Nuclear Association.

pelajaran.id: Indonesia sudah memiliki kompetensi operasi dan pengawasan reaktor riset, namun itu belum sama dengan membangun PLTN daya.
pelajaran.en: Indonesia has research reactor operating and oversight competence, which is not the same as building a power plant.
